title: Java/ data engineer
description:
Lead Java / Data Engineer - Contract

£600 per day | Inside IR35 | Fully Remote | Initial 3 Months | Long-Term Project

We are looking for an experienced SC Java / Data Engineer to join a long-term project on an initial 3-month contract, with strong potential for extensions.

Key Skills & Experience
  • Active SC clearance

  • Java: Strong hands-on development experience (Java 11 or earlier versions are fine).

  • Kafka: Experience with event-driven architectures and data streaming.

  • Kubernetes: Experience deploying and managing containerised applications.

  • AWS: Strong cloud engineering experience.

  • Data Engineering: Substantial experience building and maintaining data pipelines and large-scale data systems.

  • Backend Engineers will also be considered if they have held at least one significant data engineering role and are comfortable with hands-on development.

Contract Details

  • Rate: £600 per day

  • IR35: Inside IR35

  • Location: Fully Remote

  • Duration: Initial 3 months, long-term project with potential extensions

Interested? Get in touch with your latest CV and availability.
